sheets.label: 1:500,000 M-44-Б Leninogorsk
sheets.credit: USSR / Kazakh SSR Ministries of Geology; East Kazakhstan series; chief editor S. E. Chakabaev. Native scans / shared legend via geokniga.org.
sheets.license: Source rights remain with authors/rightsholders; no open redistribution license established. Native scans, excerpts and source-derived vectors are excluded from any repository software license. Hosting on Geokniga is not proof of an open license.
sheets.limitations: Experimental color segmentation from 160 sampled native shared-legend references, not transcribed or unique units. Candidate lists not exhaustive; hatches/text/water classification approximate. Provisional georeferencing, not field-grade. Scan printed 1979; series/catalog 1976.
sheets.accuracy: 8 labelled native frame controls; internal grid-fit RMS 1.48px, leave-one-out max 7.48px. Grid-fit and leave-one-out residuals are not absolute geographic accuracy. Picks are approximate; all controls are on frame, not surveyed landmarks. Datum assumption, paper/scanner distortion and interior alignment remain unverified. Provisional, not field-grade.
